title: model-loader Profile
description: JSON schema for a model-loader llama-server profile. Each profile is persisted as a single .json file under the profiles directory.

schemaVersion.description: Profile JSON schema version. Always 1 for current format.

id.description: Unique identifier for the profile. Used as the filename (id.json). Must be kebab-case ASCII (letters, digits, hyphens only). Auto-generated from name via Slugify when not provided.

name.description: Human-readable profile name. Displayed in the TUI.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the profile.

tags.description: Optional list of string tags for filtering/grouping in the UI.

model.description: Absolute or relative path to the GGUF model file. Validated at runtime: file must exist on disk.

args.description: Structured backend flags as key/value pairs. Each key is a flag name (canonical long form, e.g. 'ctx-size', or short alias mapped by the validator). Values must match the type declared in the backend's FlagSchema.

anyOf.description: FlagTypeInt: whole numbers (e.g. ctx-size, port, ngl). JSON numbers without fraction.
FlagTypeFloat: floating-point values (e.g. temperature). Accepts both integers and floats.
FlagTypeString: free-text values (e.g. model alias, API key).

extraArgs.description: Raw extra CLI arguments passed as-is to the backend binary. Each entry must start with '--'. Format: '--flag' or '--flag=value'. For non-bool flags without '=' the next array element is consumed as the value.

defaultBackground.description: If true, the process starts in background mode by default when launched from the TUI.

logFilePath.description: Optional custom log file path for this profile's llama-server output. Falls back to global log directory if empty.

backendId.description: Optional ID of the backend to use for launching this profile. If empty, the default backend from the catalog is used.

llamaServerBinaryPath.description: LEGACY: read-only migration field. Not written after migration. Use backend catalog instead.

meta.description: System-managed metadata. Populated automatically by the store on save.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp when the profile was last modified.

lastUsedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent launch. Null if never launched.

flagTypeNote.description: Flag value type semantics: boolean -> FlagTypeBool, integer -> FlagTypeInt, number -> FlagTypeFloat, string -> FlagTypeString. Enum flags are represented as strings restricted to a fixed set of values, validated against the backend schema's EnumValues.

argsExample.description: Example args block for a typical llama-server profile.

extraArgsExample.description: Example extraArgs demonstrating both inline-value and next-element value styles.
